name: MedStation
verdict: MedStation generated 126 leads at a $8.91 CPL over 28 days, driven almost entirely by Meta (100% of spend at $1,122.50, led by "MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP" at $1,044.51). The biggest movement is a 116.7% week-over-week spend spike that held CPL growth to just 8.35%, suggesting improved Meta efficiency, though GBP actions dropped 51.43% in the same 7-day window, worth monitoring for local visibility impact.

performance.verdict: SOW is 2.5 months overdue; ads are cheap but the stack isn't built yet.

findings.text: 10 of 10 SOW milestones are overdue (earliest due 2026-07-31): pre-launch stack test, GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta CAPI, landing pages, reactivation lanes, search campaigns, LSA, nurture sequences, and Phase 1 close — all unverified.
CPL rose 8.35% week-over-week to an implied ~$9.65 despite spend doubling +116.7%; efficiency is holding but degrading at the margin as budget scales.
3-day lead signal is weak: Oct 12–14 averaged 2.0 leads/day vs Oct 9–11 average of 4.3 leads/day, even as spend held at ~$54/day — a 53% volume drop.
GBP actions fell 51.43% week-over-week; last 4 days in series (Oct 11–14) show 0 GBP actions, suggesting a local-visibility stall unrelated to paid spend.
GA4 shows 0 conversions across 2,040 sessions (28-day window); Meta delivered 126 leads — tracking is broken or unconnected, making GA4 attribution useless for now.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 10 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer and Sohib; no budget scaling until stack test and CAPI are verified live.
suggestions.monday_update: All 10 SOW milestones due between July 31 and September 30 remain unverified — including the pre-launch stack test, GHL migration, Meta CAPI, and landing pages. No further budget increases are defensible until at minimum the end-to-end stack test and CAPI are confirmed live, per SOW gate requirements. Success check: Nacer confirms each milestone status in writing by 2026-10-18. Re-assess scaling posture at that point.

suggestions.text: Watch 3-day lead rate on MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP; if Oct 15–17 stays below 2.5 leads/day, trigger creative refresh.
suggestions.monday_update: The Oct 12–14 window averaged 2.0 leads/day versus 4.3 leads/day in Oct 9–11 — a 53% drop while spend held near $54/day. This pattern on a single campaign (MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP, $1,044.51 of $1,122.50 total spend) suggests early creative fatigue but is not yet confirmed. Check again on 2026-10-18: if leads/day remains below 2.5 for the full three days, escalate to creative refresh.

suggestions.text: Fix GA4 conversion tracking — 0 conversions across 2,040 sessions contradicts 126 Meta leads; resolve before any attribution decision.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 recorded 0 conversions across 2,040 sessions in the 28-day window while Meta reported 126 leads at $8.91 CPL — the two sources are completely disconnected. This is a tracking implementation gap, likely tied to the overdue landing pages and stack test milestone. Web/Creative team should audit the GA4 goal events and confirm they fire on the Meta lead form completion or landing page thank-you page. Success check: GA4 shows >0 conversions matching approximate Meta lead volume by 2026-10-22.
